cluster_recommendation: The five-skill methodology pentad (sparc-methodology, build-with-quality, prd2build, bhil-methodology, verification-quality) genuinely is disambiguated, not duplicative — every SKILL.md redirects to the other four by name and routing-table.md gives each distinct trigger phrases — so SKILL-DIRECTORY's 'sequential phases, not competing' claim survives testing. The real problem is CLI rot, verified directly against the installed ruflo v3.38.21 binary: `sparc` and `truth` are not recognised top-level commands at all, and `verify` exists but does something completely different (signed-witness-manifest checking, not per-file truth scoring/rollback) — verification-quality's entire command surface is fictional against this build, and ruvnet-kb's own current copy of the same upstream skill already carries a 'shipped vs. aspirational' correction that agentbox's copy never received. For 'build feature X with tests' a Fable-class model should route to build-with-quality (MCP path preferred, e.g. `mcp__claude-flow__swarm_init`/`task_orchestrate`, which are live); GPT-6 Astra via Codex has no Task-tool or Claude-only MCP path but the CLI/global-`claude-flow`-binary route works identically for both models once the `sparc`/`truth` examples are fixed — the model-fit gap here is 'stale CLI for everyone', not a Claude-vs-Codex split. security-testing/defense-security/build-with-quality's deepsec-gate have clean, non-overlapping scopes (app-layer OWASP vs Linux hardening vs automated CI diff gate) confirmed by reading all three bodies; deepsec-gate.sh and its ADR-2033 both exist and match. rust-development is thin and generic relative to the estate's Rust-first, RustCrypto-only, crates.io-publishing policy, and its frontmatter name doesn't match its directory; cuda is otherwise strong but states the wrong GPU model for two of the container's three cards (Quadro RTX 6000 vs the actual RTX 6000 Ada Generation), a correctness issue with real consequences for arch flags. The three thinking-lens skills (human-architect-mindset, vanity-engineering-review, negentropy-lens) overlap on architecture/design-decision trigger vocabulary but are angle-distinct enough not to merge; negentropy-lens remains graph-isolated only because nothing links back to it, and vanity-engineering-review's performance redirect points at the wrong skills (pytorch-ml/cuda instead of performance-analysis).
